title: Photograph 2
passage: A. A lid is being held upright in a wire rack. B. Two containers are stacked inside the rack. C. A lid has been placed flat on top of a container. D. Someone is holding a container under running water.
passageZh:
A. 有人把一個蓋子豎著拿在金屬線架裡。
B. 線架裡疊著兩個容器。
C. 有個蓋子平放在容器上方。
D. 有人把一個容器拿在流動的水下。
